text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that Community Council not authorize the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Ivorwood Crescent and Dewey Drive as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This T-type intersection currently has a stop control for the westbound movement on Dewey Drive at Ivorwood Crescent.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Ivorwood Crescent and Dewey Drive.
